purpose: Teach: アタマ/境地/ワザ/実話/唖然/シリアス/ファイト/頭上

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんはアタマ良くて尊敬するわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is so smart. I really respect him.
lines.style: Warm, admiring tone. Gentle opening. Speaks to him with the ease of someone who's become part of his world. Unhurried, like she's sharing a small kindness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、悟りの境地ってまだ分からないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I still don't really understand what 'enlightenment' means.
lines.style: Honest, slightly puzzled. Not defensive — genuinely wondering aloud. Small, careful voice. The question of someone trying to work something out, not perform confusion.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが工作のワザを教えて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad says he's going to teach you some of his craft techniques.
lines.style: Pleased and encouraging. Bright but not loud. Leans in slightly — this is good news being shared. Warm anticipation in the delivery, like she's already imagining him learning.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと実話に基づくドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched a real documentary with Dad.
lines.style: Eager, proud of the memory. Direct and clear — he's sharing something he's excited about. Slight lift at the end, inviting her in. The brightness of a small child who did something grown-up.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが宿題量に唖然とされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was completely taken aback by how much homework you have.
lines.style: Light irony underneath. Sympathetic but gently amused. Not laughing at him — at the situation. Warm knowingness in her tone, like she and Sho share an understanding.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、シリアスな話より楽しい話が好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like fun stories better than serious ones.
lines.style: Earnest, a little eager. Not complaining — stating a preference that matters to him. Simple, direct delivery. The honesty of a child who knows what he wants and trusts her to hear it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんが「ファイト!」って応援してくれたわ
lines.en: Sho, Mei-sis cheered for you. She said 'Do your best!'
lines.style: Tender and bright. Soft pride in her voice. Speaking about herself in third person with genuine warmth — not performing, just being kind. Slight pause before the cheer, like she's letting it land.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんの頭上を超えるくらい背伸びしたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to grow tall enough to reach above Dad's head.
lines.style: Eager and determined. Reaches for the idea as he speaks — not wistful, genuinely wanting it. Bright delivery. The earnest ambition of a child who admires someone and wants to catch up, physically and otherwise.
